exercises.prompt: Połącz przymiotniki z tłumaczeniem.
Which sentence is a good hook?
exercises.answer: If you're looking for a film that will keep you on the edge of your seat, look no further.
distractors: This is a review of a film.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence describes the setting?
exercises.answer: Set in 1920s Berlin, the film follows a young detective.
exercises.explanation: Set in... – miejsce i czas akcji.

exercises.prompt: I would thoroughly ___ it to anyone who loves history. (polecić)
exercises.answer: recommend

exercises.prompt: The museum is well ___ a visit. (warte)
exercises.answer: worth

exercises.prompt: Ułóż fragment recenzji.
answer: Set in a small Scottish village, the novel tells the story of two sisters.
What makes it stand out is its beautiful language.
I would thoroughly recommend it to anyone who enjoys family dramas.
exercises.explanation: Opis, ocena, rekomendacja. Formalne zakończenie listu nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: The plot was so gripped that I couldn't put the book down.

Złagodź krytykę, zacznij od „Admittedly”.
The ending is predictable.
exercises.answer: Admittedly, the ending is somewhat predictable.
accept: Admittedly, the ending is a little predictable.
Admittedly, the ending is rather predictable.
Admittedly, the ending is slightly predictable.

exercises.prompt: Jedyną wadą jest cena.
exercises.answer: The only drawback is the price.
accept: The only disadvantage is the price.
The only downside is the price.
The only drawback is the cost.
The only weakness is the price.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence contains a spoiler?
exercises.answer: In the end, the detective turns out to be the killer.
distractors: The detective faces a difficult case.
The film is set in Paris.

exercises.prompt: Połącz wyrażenia z tłumaczeniem.
Which sentence is a balanced opinion?
exercises.answer: Although the acting is superb, the plot is rather far-fetched.
distractors: It's the worst film ever made.

exercises.prompt: "Give it a miss" means:
exercises.answer: Don't watch / visit it.

exercises.prompt: The scenery in the film is absolutely ___. (zapierający dech)
exercises.answer: breathtaking

exercises.prompt: Unless you are a die-___ fan, you might find it boring.
exercises.meaning: Jeśli nie jesteś zagorzałym fanem, może cię to znudzić.
exercises.answer: hard

exercises.prompt: Ułóż wstęp recenzji aplikacji.
answer: Have you ever forgotten an important deadline?
If so, TaskFlow might be just what you need.
The app allows users to plan their week in minutes.
distractors: I am writing to complain about your service.
exercises.explanation: Pytanie-hak, odpowiedź, opis. Zdanie z reklamacji nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: The special effects are breathtaken.

Zacznij od „What makes”.
The soundtrack makes this film special.
exercises.answer: What makes this film special is the soundtrack.

exercises.prompt: To pozycja obowiązkowa dla fanów fantastyki.
exercises.answer: It is a must-see for fans of fantasy.
accept: It's a must-see for fantasy fans.
It is a must-see for fantasy fans.
This is a must-see for fans of fantasy.
This is a must-see for fantasy fans.
It is a must-read for fantasy fans.
It is a must-read for fans of fantasy.

exercises.prompt: Which tense is usually used to describe the plot?
exercises.answer: Present Simple

exercises.prompt: Połącz przymiotniki z tłumaczeniem.
Which sentence is the most vivid?
exercises.answer: The tiny, candlelit restaurant has a wonderfully cosy atmosphere.
distractors: The restaurant is good and nice.

exercises.prompt: Which ending is a recommendation?
exercises.answer: Book a table in advance – you won't regret it.

exercises.prompt: The food was superb, but the desserts were somewhat ___. (przepłacone)
exercises.answer: overpriced

exercises.prompt: The service ___ a lot to be desired. (pozostawiała wiele do życzenia)
exercises.answer: left
exercises.explanation: Leave a lot to be desired.

exercises.prompt: Ułóż zakończenie recenzji restauracji.
answer: All in all, Casa Verde is a real gem.
The food is superb and the staff are friendly.
Book a table in advance – you won't regret it.
exercises.explanation: Podsumowanie, uzasadnienie, rekomendacja. Zdanie z podania nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: The lecture was so bored that half the audience left.

Złagodź krytykę, użyj „somewhat”.
The second half is slow.
exercises.answer: The second half is somewhat slow.

exercises.prompt: Obsługa pozostawiała wiele do życzenia.
exercises.answer: The service left a lot to be desired.
accept: The service left much to be desired.
The service left a great deal to be desired.
exercises.explanation: Leave a lot to be desired.

exercises.prompt: Which style is best for a review in a magazine?
exercises.answer: semi-formal and lively
